title: Shifted small bias polynomial
statement: For natural numbers $n,\ell$ and a vector $\gamma\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$, define a polynomial over the binary extension field of degree $\ell$ by $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}\gamma_iX^i$, where each coefficient is mapped into that field by its canonical field embedding.
